title: Gear picks: How it works splash
lede: A one-time splash on a participant's first visit to /gear this cycle (normally right after the dashboard banner). Per-person kit count, budget or what's left on a draft, and the deadline with its time. A header button reopens it.

sections.heading: After only
sections.note: No before exists: the splash and its header button are new surfaces. Captures from the Claude desktop browser pane, dark appearance, authenticated local managed preview (localhost:3439, preview DB for feat/ua-gear-picks with this branch's two gear files applied), ADMIN 'Creative Admin' as a Men's participant with a submitted test list ($67.50 of a stale preview allowance of $185; production rows are $192 / $357). Opened via 'How it works' because this account has submitted, which correctly suppresses the automatic first-visit open. Pane screenshots are JPEG converted to PNG; the desktop capture is the pane's 800x562 downscale of a 1280x900 CSS viewport.

shots.title: Phone, splash
shots.cap: 390x844 CSS. Five tips, 'Start picking' closes and marks it seen for this cycle.

shots.title: Phone, header
shots.cap: 'How it works' sits beside 'See results' (admin-only) in the page header; hidden once picks close.

changes.was: The banner dropped people straight into a 130-item catalog with the budget switch, kit strip, swatches, and drafts unexplained.
changes.now: A short splash states what's already covered, what they can spend, how to preview and pick colors, that sizes come from their profile, and that edits stay open until the deadline time.
